environment.description: CI/CD runner deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 host with AppArmor in complain mode (aa-complain). Runner process executes as 'ci-runner' user with write access to /var/lib/ci-runner/workspace and /tmp. No mandatory access control enforcement. The runner accepts artifact uploads from any authenticated pipeline job. Filesystem permissions allow ci-runner to write to /etc/cron.d/, /var/spool/cron/, and other sensitive paths due to group membership in 'staff'.
